zh-CN.title: CAD 零件
zh-CN.description: 根据一段 CadQuery 脚本生成机械零件：脚本只被读取、不会被执行，结果经过测量校验后保存为 STEP、STL 和 GLB 文件。

usage.title: 描述零件并给出尺寸
usage.description: 在对话中说明零件的外形和以毫米为单位的尺寸，例如“60 × 40 × 6 的底板，两个直径 4 的通孔”。

usage.title: 查看校验结果和文件
usage.description: 助手调用 cad_build 后会给出包围盒、体积和孔径的实测值。全部通过时，STEP、STL 和 GLB 会出现在产物面板和文件视图中；未通过的零件不会生成 STEP。

requirements: 安装本扩展会同时安装 CadQuery 几何内核，占用约 1.7 GB 磁盘空间。
仅支持允许清单内的建模操作；循环、函数和其他 import 会被拒绝。

en-US.title: CAD parts
en-US.description: Build a mechanical part from a short CadQuery script. The script is read, never run; the result is measured and saved as STEP, STL and GLB files.

usage.title: Describe the part with its dimensions
usage.description: Say what the part looks like and give sizes in millimetres, for example "a 60 x 40 x 6 plate with two 4 mm through holes".

usage.title: Read the checks and open the files
usage.description: After the assistant calls cad_build it reports the measured bounding box, volume and hole diameters. When every check passes, the STEP, STL and GLB files appear in the artifact panel and the Files view. A part that fails gets no STEP file.

requirements: Installing this extension installs the CadQuery geometry kernel, about 1.7 GB on disk.
Only allow-listed modelling operations are available; loops, functions and other imports are refused.
